_comment: Age bands used to SUGGEST a member type for a person who has none. Never authoritative: the roster shows Trailblazer running 3-75 and Radical 0-35, and the types also turn on marital status and other affiliations, so a suggestion is a starting point for a person to confirm and nothing more. Only applied where the member type is empty; an existing value is never overwritten. Regenerate with tools/measure-member-type-ages.php after the roster changes materially.
